2115441893630976085.en_summary: @Stephanie_Link says $MIR saw acceleration in Nuclear and Safety revenue, backlog up 33% excluding M&A, and total orders up 85% (62% excluding M&A). The company raised 2026 organic growth to 7% to 8% from 5% to 6% with in line margins, and she says the new nuclear cycle is in its early stages.
2115441893630976085.zh_summary: @Stephanie_Link 表示 $MIR 核能及安全業務收入加速增長，撇除併購後訂單積壓增加 33%，總訂單增長 85%（撇除併購後增長 62%）。公司將 2026 年內生增長指引由 5% 至 6% 上調至 7% 至 8%，利潤率符合預期。她認為新一輪核能週期仍處於早期階段。

2115441934030590352.en_summary: @OptionsHawk says knowing the right direction is key and other providers got it wrong, pointing to a sweet climb in $BIIB. He quotes his own earlier post on Biogen $BIIB 200 March $220 short puts opened at $13.50, saying most flow apps would read them as bought, and promotes his Hawk App algo. An image is attached.
